response.overview: Childhood best friends Nashid and Eenaz are separated when he moves abroad; ten years later he returns on her birthday. At a reunion party, Eenaz's heart breaks when he introduces his wife Leena, so she hides her feelings and marries Madhih, a manager who had long harassed her. Five years on, Eenaz suffers an abusive marriage while Nashid and Leena struggle after Leena's miscarriage. When Madhih turns violent, Nashid rescues Eenaz, helps her divorce him, and hires her as his secretary. Realizing Eenaz loves him but unwilling to leave Leena, Nashid proposes polygamy; Leena reluctantly agrees and goes abroad for treatment. She returns cured just as Nashid and Eenaz grow close, so Eenaz—knowing he'll never truly love her—leaves him, revealing she's pregnant with his child.
response.title: Kalaayaanulaa
